test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In what way will King Charles’ coronation be different from Queen Elizabeth II’s ?

options.text: The ceremony will be scaled down
It will not follow the old traditions
St Edward’s crown will be used for the coronation.
The coronation procession will be much grander.

solution:
The correct answer is **"The ceremony will be scaled down".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Comparison to previous coronation: The passage indicates that the coronation of the next British King will be different from Queen Elizabeth II's coronation. The most striking difference is that it will be smaller in scale compared to the 1953 event 
 
• Traditions and the crown: While the ceremony will aim to reflect the modern role of the monarch, it will still be rooted in longstanding traditions, ruling out option 2. It also mentioned that St Edward's Crown would still be used for the coronation, negating option 3.
 
• Regarding the procession, although the coronation procession will be larger in terms of the people who are part of it (with more members of the Royal Family joining), it is expected to be more modest overall, which goes against option 4.

**Hence, the correct answer is 'Option 1'.**
